items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday; ETR comprehensive injury report groups him under DOUBTFUL while Adams expected to handle primary load.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury list; corroborated by Schefter (McVay: barring setback return next week) and Rapoport (not expected, Adams carry load).
items.implication: Adams elevated to WR1 usage/routes/targets; Nacua likely misses second straight.
items.opportunity: Adams routes/target rate spike without Nacua (prior 42% target rate on routes sans Nacua).

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday; Mariota to start. Rapoport notes positive longer-term (not IR, surgery not on table).
items.why: Official ruling; ETR OUT list; Rapoport good news longer-term.
items.implication: McLaurin target share historically solid with Mariota (~25%) but tough SEA matchup and low team total; Berry hates McLaurin this week.
items.opportunity: McLaurin volume holds but efficiency risk; check Mariota chemistry.
items.conflict: Berry notes McLaurin value not fully tanked long-term but hates vs SEA.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins for Sunday at Indianapolis due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Official team ruling confirmed by Schefter; ETR lists OUT; Rapoport corroborates.
items.implication: Schultz sees elevated targets (30% routes, 28% share last week sans Collins); Colts allow 4th-most TE yards.
items.opportunity: Schultz target share and red-zone upside expands.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe) for Sunday vs Bengals; Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder).
items.why: Official; ETR OUT; coach: Warren will lead the group.
items.implication: Warren clear lead back with checkdown upside from Rodgers; backups Homer/Heidenreich.
items.opportunity: Warren snaps/carries/routes/third-down expand significantly; Levitan projects high checkdown volume.

items.text: Projecting Qs Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) in as of now despite questionable tags. Clarity hoped early on Flowers/Mitchell/Moore.
items.implication: Start them if projected; monitor final inactive.
items.opportunity: Full roles if active; Bowers TE1 upside, Evans volume, Warren lead.

items.text: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey listed IN (off injury report, good to go); Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle). Schefter confirms Broncos RBs active except Coleman.
items.why: ETR IN list; Schefter official off report.
items.implication: Committee continues; Coleman (who had 83% snaps last when Dobbins left) out removes one option.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers Coleman long-term ROS.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes) for Week 3 main slate.
items.why: ETR sims/projections live; record high ceiling.
items.implication: Elite DFS tournament play and smash spot; high upside RB1.
items.opportunity: Snap/route/target/carry share elite; matchup allows big plays.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead Steelers RBs; vertical pass not working for Rodgers so expect zillion checkdowns. Projecting Warren (Q shoulder) in. Backups Homer + Heidenreich.
items.why: Coach comments + Dowdle OUT; Levitan usage/opportunity focus.
items.implication: Warren RB2+ with pass-game work; high floor via checkdowns.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + routes + third-down/two-minute; goal-line possible.

items.text: Davante Adams ran 142 routes without Nacua as Ram, targeted on 42%; prior games sans Nacua: 5-35-3 and 8-195-2. Expect heavy routes/targets.
items.why: Historical usage data when Nacua out; Nacua doubtful again.
items.implication: Adams WR1 with massive target share/routes this week.
items.opportunity: Primary target; red-zone and deep work expands.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (only 5 games in 3 seasons); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.why: Berry Love/Hate + 10 Facts context; ETR lists Brooks OUT.

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
items.opportunity: High carry volume vs poor run D; goal-line.

items.text: LOVE Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week sans Collins; IND allows 4th-most TE yards. Also 10 Facts notes 30% routes targeted.
items.why: Usage spike confirmed + matchup; Collins OUT solidifies.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% third-down snaps even with Kamara active; role not there (RB37 util).
items.why: Low snap/touch share; ETR has him IN but usage poor.
items.conflict: ETR lists IN but opportunity limited vs usage data.

items.text: After Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson led Patriots backfield 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but still ranks Stevenson ahead Week 3.
items.implication: Henderson rising but not full lead; monitor split. Berry hates Stevenson this week (low snaps post-fumble + tough JAX run D).
items.opportunity: Henderson snap share expansion potential; pass pro still limits.
